messages:
maria: Kicking off blue/green tilt for inference-router v2.0 -> v2 (eu-west) now. Plan: 10% increments every 5m, probe + warmup, cookie-based session affinity pinned for 20m after shift. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-inference-router-v2
chris: Copy. I'll prime caches and watch KV hit rates during the 0->10 step. Will post smoke results.
tanya: I'll run the smoke probe and synthetic latency checks. curl probe: `curl -sS -H 'x-canary: 1' https://eu-west-internal/router/healthz`
deploy-bot: deploy started: router-config apply (change-id: cfg-8021) -> routing weights: v2=0%, v1=100%
deploy-bot: routing update applied -> v2=10% (step 1).
chris: cache priming logs show steady increase, p50 okay, p95 +5ms. KV miss rate dropping.
zane: Alerting: +2.1% 502 spike over baseline at 12:32 UTC during 10% window. Small but trending.
tanya: I reran smoke probe — healthz returns 200 but one backend returned 502 when probing longer paths (\`/model/infer?seq=2048\`). Adding trace.
maria: Pause the shift, hold at 10%. Do not proceed to 20%. @chris can you tail the backend logs and check connection errors?
chris: tailing logs: see intermittent worker OOMs on one pod (node eu-west-2b). Repro on v2 only. Looks like batch size/quantization mismatch for that variant.
deploy-bot: routing update requested -> HOLD (no change).
maria: Good catch. Initiate rollback for router config (pin back to v1). We'll do a selective rollback of routing weights to 0% v2. @zane please run the rollback cmd when ready.
zane: Running rollback command: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/internal/route/update -d '{"service":"inference-router","weights":{"v2":0}}'`
deploy-bot: routing update applied -> v2=0%, v1=100% (rollback complete).
maria: Thanks. We'll file a postmortem and block v2 until the OOMs are fixed. Chris/Tanya, can you capture a minimal repro and attach to the release issue?
chris: Will do — grabbing heap profiles and model config diffs now.
tanya: Captured traces + failing request examples and linked to https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-1729.
maria: We'll reschedule a smaller canary (5% with explicit memory cap) after regression fix. For now, marking the change window closed early. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
zane: Noted. Tagging infra to check node eu-west-2b health.
deploy-bot: deployment activity summary: step-started 10% -> paused -> rollback -> complete. No consumer-facing error spike after rollback.
chris: Adding note to release notes: "v2.0 rollout paused due to memory OOM on a v2 backend; rollback applied. Next attempt after fix."
maria: Closing thread. If anything else pops after rollback, ping here.
